facts.statement: The Damage effect targets shields before HP.
facts.sourceSentence: Damage - Hits player's shields first, if blocked, then HP if any carries over.

facts.statement: If damage exceeds shield capacity, the remaining damage carries over to HP.
facts.sourceSentence: if blocked, then HP if any carries over.

facts.statement: The Power/Sentience effect moves the corresponding token up or down the Doom Machine track.
facts.sourceSentence: Power / Sentience - Move the corresponding token up or down the Doom Machine track.

facts.statement: The Power + Sentience effect increases or decreases both Power and Sentience simultaneously.
facts.sourceSentence: Power + Sentience - Increase or decrease both Power and Sentience.

facts.statement: When the Broken Shield effect activates, only one shield die can be placed on the next turn.
facts.sourceSentence: Broken Shield - When activated, only 1 shield dice can be placed next turn.

facts.statement: The Destroy Effect activates immediately when a part card is destroyed.
facts.sourceSentence: Destroy Effect - Immediately triggers when a part card is destroyed.

facts.statement: The Repair effect restores a part card's HP, up to its maximum starting health value.
facts.sourceSentence: Repair - Restores part card's HP (only up to its maximum starting health).

facts.statement: The Gear effect instantly triggers an additional track cycle for any cards immediately adjacent to it.
facts.sourceSentence: Gear - Instantly triggers an additional track cycle for any cards immediately adjacent to it.

facts.statement: The Lock effect lets you choose one of your dice and set it aside so it cannot be rolled or placed on your next turn.
facts.sourceSentence: Lock - Choose one of your die and set it aside. It does not get rolled or placed on your next turn.

facts.statement: There are eight circular icon badges arranged in a column.
facts.sourceSentence: eight circular icon badges in a column

facts.statement: The icon badges are displayed on a dark teal card back.
facts.sourceSentence: dark teal card back

facts.statement: Each icon badge is surrounded by a ring in a distinct color.
facts.sourceSentence: each ringed in a distinct color on a dark teal card back

facts.statement: The Damage icon is a yellow and green starburst or explosion glyph.
facts.sourceSentence: Damage: a yellow/green starburst or explosion glyph.

facts.statement: The Power icon is a black and teal battery or power-cell glyph.
facts.sourceSentence: a battery/power-cell glyph (Power, black/teal)

facts.statement: The Sentience icon is a yellow eye glyph.
facts.sourceSentence: an eye glyph (Sentience, yellow)

facts.statement: The Power and Sentience effects are represented by two side-by-side badges.
facts.sourceSentence: two side-by-side badges — a battery/power-cell glyph (Power, black/teal) and an eye glyph (Sentience, yellow)

facts.statement: The Power + Sentience combined effect icon is an eye glyph badge.
facts.sourceSentence: an eye glyph badge (shown for the combined effect)

facts.statement: The Broken Shield icon is a green cracked shield glyph.
facts.sourceSentence: a green cracked shield glyph.

facts.statement: The Destroy Effect icon is a yellow circled X.
facts.sourceSentence: a yellow circled X.

facts.statement: The Repair icon is a yellow heart with a triangle.
facts.sourceSentence: a yellow heart with a triangle.

facts.statement: The Gear icon is a cogwheel glyph in a blue ring.
facts.sourceSentence: a cogwheel glyph in a blue ring.

facts.statement: The Lock icon is a padlock glyph in an orange ring.
facts.sourceSentence: a padlock glyph in an orange ring.
